one_line: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO amid investigations and affairs, while Anthropic drew heavy IPO orders and OpenAI launched new security tools and payment features.

themes.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
themes.text: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned after admitting to personal relationships with a subordinate and a woman identified as a Chinese spy, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO. Congressional lawmakers launched inquiries into Nvidia's chip sales to China and trade deals, while Senate officials invited Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify.

themes.title: Anthropic IPO draws heavy orders
themes.text: Anthropic's IPO is about six times oversubscribed as the company targets a $1.4 trillion valuation. Meanwhile, cloud provider Nscale disclosed a $1.69 billion net loss and $5.5 billion in debt in an amended IPO filing, and Nebius outlined a $40 to $45 billion capital expenditure plan for 2027.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO draws about six times the orders for available shares

Nscale reports $5.5B in debt and $1.69B loss in amended IPO filing

themes.title: OpenAI launches security and payment tools
themes.text: OpenAI launched the Daybreak security platform and the ChatGPT Wallet payment feature to let AI agents make purchases for U.S. Pro subscribers. The company also disbanded its standalone robotics team as general models take over those applications.

OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent shopping
